title: Mystic Apothecary Workshop
description: A female alchemist or witch in a purple robe and green headscarf stands behind a wooden counter in a magical shop. She reaches toward a glowing red potion while an open spellbook, scrolls, and countless glowing bottles and crystals fill the shelves and workspace around her.
prompt: A detailed fantasy scene of a female alchemist wearing a purple patterned robe and green headscarf working at a wooden counter inside a magical apothecary. Shelves behind her are filled with glowing teal and green potion bottles, crystals, and magical ingredients. She reaches for a glowing red potion as an open spellbook and ancient scrolls with maps and figures lie on the counter. Warm magical lighting, purple banners with symbols, mistletoe, highly detailed digital painting style.
